title: The Living Room
friction_meter: retired for Part 9; replaced by the before-and-after room signature
part9_signature_state: before-and-after room card of the sofa, coffee table, and media wall from the doorway; before kept (Ch 6), after the ideal-state standard (Ch 25)
shine_layer: soft furnishings, screens, and dust that becomes heat; clean where nobody looks and match the tool to the surface
dust_and_touch_rule: In the living room, dust is not just untidy, it is heat, allergens, and lost light: it mats the vents that keep your electronics cool, it settles deep in the upholstery, and it films the bulb until the lamp barely lights. So you clean where nobody looks, and you match the tool to the surface: a dry cloth on a screen, a soft brush on a vent, the upholstery tool deep in the seams.

reframes.dust_is_heat: A television or a games console does not usually die of age, it dies of dust...
reframes.clean_where_nobody_looks: Most of what a living room needs cleaning is exactly where you never look...
reframes.screen: A screen is the one surface in the house you never spray and never scrub...

the_six_zones: the sofa and seating, the coffee table, the media center, the bookshelves and display, the side tables and lighting, and the floor and circulation path

sofa_and_seating.purpose: somewhere everyone can sit without first moving something
inputs: vacuum with upholstery and crevice tools
key_steps: lift every seat cushion, vacuum both faces
crevice tool into the deck and seams
sofa_and_seating.inspect: musty foam, flexing frame, split seams, worn-shiny fabric

coffee_table.purpose: a small shared surface for what is happening now
key_steps: clear to bare, glass takes two passes
coffee_table.inspect: cracked glass, rocking leg, heat bloom, bowing shelf

media_center.purpose: keep the TV, sound, and consoles working, cool, and cabled
inputs: microfiber set with a screen cloth (dry only)
key_steps: back panel and every vent slot (dust is heat)
media_center.inspect: scorched smell, warm strip, louder fan, matted vent, heat-stiff cable

bookshelves_and_display.purpose: the books you will open again and a few objects
bookshelves_and_display.inspect: bowed board, crept pin, slack strap, foxing

side_tables_and_lighting.purpose: a light, a drink, and one or two things by the chair
key_steps: wipe the bulb off and cold (dust steals light)
side_tables_and_lighting.inspect: flickering bulb, scorched shade, cracked cord, heat bloom

floor_and_circulation_path.purpose: cross the room in the dark carrying something
key_steps: under the sofa and chair legs
floor_and_circulation_path.inspect: smooth gripper pad, worn walk-line, creaking board, springy patch under the rug

the_calls: the pillows you move to sit down
the book you are in the middle of
whether there is simply too much furniture
definition: A finished living room is one anyone can walk into, cross in the dark, and sit down in without moving a thing...
one_idea_to_keep: A living room is not clean because the middle is tidy. It is clean because you lifted the cushions and vacuumed the deck, brushed the dust out of the vents, dusted the top of the bookcase and the edges of the books, wiped the bulb, and cleared the route from door to door.
keywords: how to clean a living room
